messages:
jia: Quick sync — we need a compact playbook for the marketplace launch this quarter. Key pieces: press embargo timing, two landing page variants (product + partner spotlight), SI co-marketing assets, hardware partner quote and legal signoff. Who can own which?

olivia: I can take press + timeline. Thinking embargo + blog + social cadence. Propose embargo date `2026-05-05`, blog same day, socials stagger 24/48h. Thoughts? :calendar:

sam: I'll own the marketplace listings (AWS/GCP marketplace checklists) and the listing copy. Need landing page copy + hero assets from marketing.

maria-legal: I can do partner quote and legal review but need the exact quote text and partner attribution draft by Wednesday EOD to do a quick review. Also flag: hardware partners often require logo usage agreement — have we collected LOUs?

marcos: SI enablement deck is at 80%. I'll upload draft to Drive in `Partners/Enablement/Sprint1` and share edit link. Will include co-branded slide and one customer use-case.

nora-marketing: Landing page variants — can do product-focused page + partner spotlight template. Will need 2 hero images (platform + partner HW). Can we get high-res logos and partner hero shots?

henry-dd: For the hardware partner quote, let's keep it short and technical (latency/cost delta). Suggested template: "Using Redwood Inference on {{HW}} reduced average P99 by Xms and cut inference cost by Y%" — partner to fill X/Y.

jia: @maria-legal and @nora-marketing I'll ping partners for LOUs and hero shots. @marcos please drop the deck link here when ready.

marcos: Uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/enablement-deck-v1 (comment-only for partners).

olivia: Press checklist quick notes — embargo FAQ, spokesperson quote, press kit (assets + one-pager), spokesperson availability windows. I can draft the spokesperson quote if we get technical quote from Henry.

maria-legal: Also need to confirm any regulatory claims in the PR (no HIPAA/PII claims unless vetted). If partner wants performance numbers public, require partner sign-off form.

sam: Marketplace checklist items I need from product: SKU names, pricing tiers, trial mechanics, billing contact, and a short tech bullet list (3 bullets).

nora-marketing: I'll sketch the two landing pages and drop mocks into Figma by tomorrow noon. Will mark places where partner quote and CTA change.

partner-bot: Reminder: marketplace asset deadline in 72h per LaunchPlan (task #LP-347).

jia: Actions: Olivia = press timeline + draft quote; Nora = landing mocks; Marcos = enablement deck; Sam = listings copy; Maria = legal review by Wed EOD; Henry = draft technical quote template; Jia = collect LOUs & partner hero shots. We'll reconvene Fri 10:30 PT for final signoff. Anyone can't make it?

marcos: FYI I added a short checklist in the deck: "legal LOUs, hero images, partner bios, technical quote" — ticked none yet.

olivia: I'll schedule the Fri 10:30 PT call and share calendar invite. :white_check_mark:

maria-legal: I should be able to join. If anything slips, I'll send review comments in the doc.

nora-marketing: All good on my side.

henry-dd: Ping me for numbers — I have preliminary perf run results, can craft X/Y placeholders today.

jia: Great — thanks team. I'll follow up with partner outreach now and post updates in this thread.
